# Uploaded Roadster asset

Source: the project owner's `tesla-roadster-20.zip`, containing `26_10_23_23_57_30_974.glb`.

`roadster.glb` preserves all source mesh accessor bytes. Body textures remain at 2048 pixels; wheel maps are resized for web use. `roadster.glb.gz` is the compressed delivery copy.

The source contains one connected body shell and four wheel assemblies, with no cockpit or separate movable hood/doors. Runtime wheel pivots and cinematic effects are added by the website.

The archive has no separate license or creator document. This repository does not grant an independent license to the supplied exterior asset. Website credits do not claim model authorship.
